profile.summary: Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js library internals and documentation. Demonstrates deep understanding of charting library APIs, data structures, and user-facing documentation improvements. Skilled in structuring complex technical information into accessible formats (e.g., options tables, interactive examples) while maintaining awareness of API versioning and deprecations. Contributions focus on enhancing developer experience through better documentation patterns and self-contained examples. Evidence suggests strong collaboration with maintainers and familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript codebase organization.
